user.text:
I want a small app for keeping track of the books I'm reading.

When I open it I want to see what I'm currently reading and what I've finished. I want to add a book from a form, mark one as finished, and click through to a book to see its title, author and my notes. I'd like to be able to send someone a link to a single book.

Nothing fancy and no accounts. Skip the database, save the books to a JSON file so they're still there after a restart.

history.assistant:
I added a Node HTTP server that saves books to data/books.json, plus endpoints to add books, list them, view one, and mark one finished. I also built the HTML and JavaScript for the bookshelf and shareable /books/:id pages, and added start, build, and test scripts.

This is not finished or verified: I haven’t added the stylesheet or run the app or tests yet.

tool_steps.assistant: I’ll inspect the existing project, then build the smallest version that fits its stack. I’ll use a JSON file for persistence and check the main flows.
